question: Does the public web expose a stable digital-scan locator for the exact 1951 issue 9 beyond library holdings, and if so what can be claimed without treating an unverified commercial scan manifest as article-text authority or as proof of lawful public download?
answer: Yes, at locator level only. A public 51gushu package manifest for 《文物》/《文物参考资料》 explicitly lists the 1951 folder and file wwck195109.pdf with displayed size 9.73 MB; the same manifest pattern is also surfaced by a separate search-indexed copy at xy980.com. The reviewed 51gushu page exposes a package listing, not the PDF object bytes or an authoritative provenance chain. No public direct object URL, file hash, page count, scan source, completeness, rights basis, or page-level text is recovered. Therefore wwck195109.pdf becomes a high-value filename locator for further lawful discovery only. It contributes zero direct Zhao Wanli text and cannot be cited as proof of the original issue's contents.
